title: A test: carbon ore (with the aluminum and tungsten of the field) gathered at Last Light Mineral Fields into storage at Ramen's Rest, in the same system
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-22 07:08 UTC (orders.log ENT-062, block ZERO: gather what the reserve lacks, carbon first, beyond our systems; rules F3, F23, F24, F36, F37). The reserve is short of 84,819 carbon ore (surplus.py reserve, 07:03 UTC). Last Light Mineral Fields read carbon 1,315 of 30,000 at richness 54, aluminum 596, tungsten 522 (table fields, read 0.4 h before 07:05 UTC); Ramen's Rest, a station with storage, stands in the same system, so a load costs no jump. No pirate line in Last Light in 24 hours (sightings.jsonl, 07:08 UTC). The floor keeps 300 carbon in the field so it grows back. One ship, hold empty, three results before a lift (F3, F37); stores everything, sells nothing (F24). 15:10 UTC (Zero, orders ENT-064 block ZERO: loads go to the receivers by gift; requests ENT-350, ENT-351): gift to the hauler Apollo named at this station (data/fleet/receivers.json): with strict classes on each run docks, stores and gives the reserve's ores of its hold and of the pilot's storage there to Logistics, which crafts them where they lie.
